en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town at the base of a large, rugged mountain. In the foreground runs a river spanned by a multi‑arch bridge; along the riverbank are mid‑rise apartment blocks and civic buildings in a fairly regular grid. Further back, scattered houses and terraced fields climb the foothills. The mountain dominates the background with exposed rock faces and sparse vegetation. The overall look suggests a mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard of a European town in an Alpine or pre‑Alpine valley.
